name: Lords of Waterdeep

categories.label: Victory points on the scoring track
categories.hint: VP gained during 8 rounds from Quests, Buildings, Intrigue and the VP tokens (before final scoring).

categories.label: Adventurers left in Tavern
categories.labelVi: Nhà thám hiểm còn trong Tavern
categories.hint: 1 VP per Adventurer cube remaining in your Tavern.

categories.label: Gold in Tavern
categories.hint: 1 VP per 2 Gold (rounded down). Enter total Gold.

categories.label: Lord card bonus
categories.hint: Bonus VP as specified on your secret Lord card (e.g. per Quest type or Building controlled); reveal at end.

tiebreakers.description: Tie: player with the most Gold (raw Gold, not Gold/2) wins.

notes: family: set-collection (running VP + end bonuses). Game ends after round 8. Tiebreak is raw Gold held (not Gold/2) - goldPairs column only approximates it. Mandatory Intrigue/plot quest effects and Skullport/Undermountain expansions not itemised; expansion Lord cards still enter as lordBonus.

sources.title: Lords of Waterdeep Rulebook (Wizards of the Coast)
